label: Salt aerosol mass out per nozzle (g/day)
tito_method: Tito: particle rate x CCN-window fraction x mass of one dry 150 nm sphere x seconds per day (B13 = B8*B9*B12*86400 chain).
literature_method: Mass conservation: seawater flow x seawater density x salt mass fraction x 86,400 s x measured mass closure = 0.41 mL/s x 1.03 g/mL x 0.030 x 86,400 x 0.91.
locator: Sect. 2.4 (3.0% salt by mass, seawater 1.03 g/cm3); Sect. 3 (0.41 mL/s; mass closure 91% for the final nozzle)
caveat: No window correction: the share of salt MASS inside 30-1000 nm is not reported. Mass closure is for the lab tunnel.

label: Aerosol tonnage for 1 K of global cooling (Tg/yr, before survival)
tito_method: Tito: per-model K per Tg/yr (Hirasawa 2026, J. Climate, not checked) restated to 150 nm.
literature_method: Emission for -2 W/m2 across nine ESMs (7-93 Tg/yr) divided by 2 x (0.96 K / 1.9 W/m2) from the GeoMIP G4cdnc ensemble medians.
papers: Hirasawa et al. 2026 preprint; Stjern et al. 2018
locator: Hirasawa preprint abstract (7 to 93 Tg/yr for -2 W/m2); Stjern 2018 abstract (median ERF -1.9 W/m2, median cooling -0.96 K)
caveat: Assumes linear scaling; different model sets and regions; the Hirasawa preprint emission sizes are not restated to Tito's 150 nm basis.

label: Fraction of sprayed particles that can activate (CCN fraction)
tito_method: Tito: 0.71, the share of particles between 30 and 1000 nm (lab size distribution).
literature_method: Field estimate: about 100 of 155 per cm3 added aerosol at cloud base could form CCN assuming a 50 nm activation diameter = 0.645.
locator: Discussion, paragraph on critical diameter (about 50 nm at 0.5% SS, about 73 nm at 0.2% SS)
caveat: One flight day (12 Feb); activation diameter inferred by the authors from a published sample.
